responsibility: Declares LONGREAL-to-string conversion helpers that return dynamically allocated strings in floating-point, engineering, and fixed-point formats. This module forms the formatting side of the ISO long-real conversion subsystem, supplying reusable textual renderings that higher-level LongConv, LongIO, and LongStr code consume.
same_name_distinction: This file declares the LONGREAL string-formatting API only; the same-stem ConvStringLong.mod contains the actual formatting algorithms and specifically targets LONGREAL via ldtoa rather than REAL formatting.
